brandSources.what: Decision: partly match the page the story starts from, not the company's whole brand
brandSources.from: https://www.tribalscale.com/in-focus/sheetal-jaitly (rendered in a browser, 2026-09-30) and node scripts/brand-probe.mjs https://www.tribalscale.com
brandSources.note: Jaitly has no personal site; his profile lives inside tribalscale.com, so the nearest 'own' identity is that profile page (black canvas, yellow button, italic Bodoni Moda name). I borrow that canvas, accent and display face because it is the page the user pointed me at and playbook 4-brand says matching colours is fine for an honest study. I deliberately do NOT use TribalScale's logo or wordmark, the wordmark is his name in the profile's own display style, and the disclaimer says it is independent. Reason for restraint: this is a story about a person, part of it covers the company's 2020 insolvency, and a full company-branded look could read as company-made or company-approved. Cluster colours are muted neighbours of the palette rather than a rainbow.

brandSources.note: Bodoni Moda and Work Sans are both on Google Fonts (one optional request; page works without it). Body = Work Sans is my choice among the site's sans faces (closest to the body text in the screenshot); the wordmark uses Bodoni Moda via 'display'. If the renderer does not italicise the wordmark, it will show upright Bodoni Moda, an approximation of the site's italic name.
